recognize_zh: 低倍血片中血小板數量充足甚至偏多，箭頭所指是接近紅血球大小的巨大血小板（giant platelets），紅血球大小一致、未見明顯碎片，符合 del(5q) MDS 常見的「巨球性貧血但血小板不低」表現。
features: Platelets numerous and evenly distributed, without thrombocytopenia
Large to giant platelets approaching red cell size (arrows)
Red cells relatively uniform and normochromic; macrocytosis is difficult to gauge at this low magnification
Occasional segmented neutrophil and a small lymphocyte in the field
No schistocytes, nucleated red cells or circulating blasts identified
describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows adequate to increased platelets with scattered large to giant platelet forms (arrows). Red cells appear relatively uniform and normochromic; the reported macrocytosis cannot be reliably judged at this magnification but may be estimated against the small lymphocyte in the field. A segmented neutrophil is present, and no schistocytes, nucleated red cells or blasts are seen. In a patient with macrocytic anemia, preserved or increased platelet counts with atypical large platelets are characteristic of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: ET shows marked thrombocytosis with large platelets but normocytic red cells and no anemia, with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations rather than del(5q).
Megaloblastic anemia shows oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, usually with mild thrombocytopenia rather than preserved counts with giant platelets.
Bernard-Soulier or MYH9-related disorders have giant platelets with low platelet counts and, in MYH9 disease, Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions.
